insights.summary: Finance and procurement push back on paying separately for add-ons (PreSense, QM seats, AI Voice Agent minutes) at renewal.
insights.quote: for 2027 they want one bundled number that covers call tracking, signal ai and the voice agent minutes, not presense & qm priced separately on top

insights.summary: Customer links "add-on pricing friction at renewal" to the renewal decision.
insights.quote: also fyi we've had a couple of inbound calls from other vendors lately. nothing signed, but with the pricing thing sitting open it's coming up in leadership meetings
